question: Choose the INCORRECT statement
options: The Tay Son Uprising first emerged as a peasant movement and later on successfully overthrew all of the corrupted governments Trịnh and Nguyễn
The country of Vietnam was mostly reunited for the first time after 200 years of division, since the Le-Mac War and later on the Trinh-Nguyen War
In 1789, The Tay Son army under the leadership of Nguyen Hue decisively smashed the invading army of Mongol Dynasty
During the era of Tay Son, the battle was fought not only by swords and spears but also by a significant numbers of cannons
correctAnswer: In 1789, The Tay Son army under the leadership of Nguyen Hue decisively smashed the invading army of Mongol Dynasty
selectedAnswer: The Tay Son Uprising first emerged as a peasant movement and later on successfully overthrew all of the corrupted governments Trịnh and Nguyễn
viTranslation:
Dịch ý câu hỏi: Chọn phát biểu sai.
Nghĩa đáp án: Năm 1789, quân Tây Sơn dưới sự lãnh đạo của Nguyễn Huệ đã đánh tan quân xâm lược của triều Mông Cổ
viExplanation: Ý chính: câu này thuộc nhóm lịch sử Việt Nam. Câu này yêu cầu tìm phát biểu sai/không đúng, nên đừng chọn phương án nghe quen nếu nó không khớp dữ kiện. Đáp án cần nhớ là “Năm 1789, quân Tây Sơn dưới sự lãnh đạo của Nguyễn Huệ đã đánh tan quân xâm lược của triều Mông Cổ” (In 1789, The Tay Son army under the leadership of Nguyen Hue decisively smashed the invading army of Mongol Dynasty).
whyCorrect: Trong bộ đề gốc, phương án “In 1789, The Tay Son army under the leadership of Nguyen Hue decisively smashed the invading army of Mongol Dynasty” là đáp án đúng. Khi ôn, hãy tự che đáp án rồi đọc lại từ khóa trong câu hỏi: “Choose the INCORRECT statement”.

Gặp INCORRECT thì phải tìm phương án sai.

question: What is NOT TRUE about Family Life in the SRV?
options: The customs and values that once defined the Vietnamese in the pre-colonial times have suffered from the intrusion of the modern industrial world

Concern for the care of aging parents as well as the related notion of family honor remain at the core of the Vietnamese value system, but their past definitions have become murkier, and expectations have diminished
Parents, relatives, and friends still somewhat attempt to match the parties (such as the parents choose criteria based on the social standing of the counterpart family)
correctAnswer: Parents, relatives, and friends still somewhat attempt to match the parties (such as the parents choose criteria based on the social standing of the counterpart family)
selectedAnswer: Concern for the care of aging parents as well as the related notion of family honor remain at the core of the Vietnamese value system, but their past definitions have become murkier, and expectations have diminished

Dịch ý câu hỏi: Điều gì không đúng về đời sống gia đình ở CHXHCN Việt Nam?

viExplanation: Ý chính: câu này thuộc nhóm văn học, nghệ thuật và mỹ thuật Việt Nam. Câu này yêu cầu tìm phát biểu sai/không đúng, nên đừng chọn phương án nghe quen nếu nó không khớp dữ kiện. question: Choose the TRUE statement about the Vietnamese Family in Pre-colonial Times
options: The "clan" included a number of families relating to each other through a common male ancestor
All clans in the society have a common lineage name or surname
In this period, "Pham" is the most common lineage name or surname
